title: Listing packages
description: Manage service packages that providers offer for their listings.

help.title: About listing packages
help.overview: A package is a priced level of a listing, such as Basic, Standard or Premium. When a client orders a package, its price and delivery days replace the listing's.

sections.title: Each package
items: It belongs to one listing; only that listing's provider can add or remove its packages.
Display order sorts packages on the listing, lowest first.
Add-ons chosen with a package must use its currency.
A listing doesn't need packages; without one, its own price is used.
